verdict.rationale: Paperspace offers an "ML in a Box" template preinstalled with major ML frameworks and CUDA drivers, and machine creation lets you pick an OS or a saved custom template, which covers the PyTorch/CUDA part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows dedicated vLLM or ComfyUI templates, and there is no independent corroboration that the templates work as described. missing for 10: dedicated vLLM and ComfyUI templates, an explicit catalog of pre-built templates naming PyTorch, hands-on or community corroboration of template launches.
